plain_english_revision: The amendment changes the definition of 'video lottery' to explicitly exclude all forms of bingo and pari-mutuel wagering.
candidate_position_supported: This amendment restricts the scope of what constitutes a 'video lottery' by excluding specific gambling activities (bingo and pari-mutuel wagering) from that definition.
evidence_quotes: On page 4, line 23, after "chance." insert the following: All forms of bingo and pari-mutuel wagering are excluded from the definition of video lottery and video lottery terminal.
